svg.title: Simulator dashboard tour
svg.desc: Actual simulator screenshot with six numbered markers. Temperature and reported target are readbacks. Session status reports monitoring, connection and CSV rows. The graph shows history; controls request a validated Celsius target or change the software connection.

g.text: Latest reading and its age; a dash means unavailable.
Confirm the device target after submitting a change.
Check backend, last poll, recording and row count.
Solid temperature; dashed target; UTC time axis.
Enter Celsius within the displayed coolant limits.
Connect / retry or disconnect the software device.
